caseName: Gross v. Title Insurance & Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Gross v. Title Insurance & Trust Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Henry Cross, pro se, and Calvin S. Mauk for appellants., Mr. Arch H. Vernon for Title Guarantee & Trust Co. et al., and Mr. U. S. Webb, Attorney General, for State of California, appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal herein is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Section 238, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 938); § 266, Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936, 938); Stratton v. St. Louis S. W. Ry., 282 U. S. 10, 15-16; U. S. Naturopathic Assn. v. Chiropractic League, 296 U. S. 539.
